answer_1.quote: We propose an approach ... that marries knowledge tracing ... with a controlled text generation model that generates the next exercise ... We ground our study in the domain of language learning to create exercise sentences for translation ...

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics include reference-based BLEU and METEOR, KC-Coverage which is the percentage of target knowledge components ... D-MAE which is the mean absolute error between the input difficulty and output difficulty, Invalid which is the percentage of exercises that have grammar errors ...
